# Richard Nordqvist

> E-commerce strategist, consultant and owner-operator based in Oslo (Norway) and Gothenburg (Sweden). 15 years building and running online stores across Norway, Sweden and Estonia.

## About
- Helps companies build and run online stores end to end: strategy and concept development, marketing and SEO, web and UX, warehouse and logistics, and AI automation for day-to-day operations.
- Specialises in cross-border e-commerce between Norway and Sweden, and from Sweden to the rest of Europe: shipping, customs and VAT.
- Platforms: Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce. Builds with AI tools such as Claude Code and Cursor.
- Company: Scomber Ltd.
- Education: BI Norwegian Business School (Siviløkonom, MSc).

## Own projects
- [Festkompaniet](https://festkompaniet.no): party supplies, Norway
- [Ballonglevering](https://ballonglevering.no): balloon delivery, Norway
- [Poppis](https://poppis.com): premium Scandinavian children's basics (co-founder)
- [Decopop](https://decopop.com): coming soon
- [PerfectHome](https://perfecthome.com): home and interior
